mutations.name: a code excerpt is not read as code content
kills: resolver tables routes a beat with a code excerpt to the code walk whatever its job

mutations.name: a cast-in-motion beat may resolve to a still template
kills: resolver tables resolves a cast-in-motion beat to a moving layer and refuses one authored as a still template

mutations.name: refused beats do not stop the resolver
kills: resolver tables throws one ResolveError naming every refused beat
